content_zh:
《一婚还比一婚高》全集
作者：晨雾的光
声明:本书由奇书网()自网络收集整理制作,仅供交流学习使用,版权归原作者和出版社所有,如果喜欢,请支持正版.
☆、这婚也能结？
真钰，我妈说房子已经装修得差不多了，让——让双方家长再见见面，看看——再添置些什么东西。夏真钰听着手机里李巍有些结巴的声音暗自叹了口气。
我正在外面和丽丽吃饭呢，等会我过一趟吧。说完不等对方再回答就挂了电话，看着坐在对面的高梅丽一脸无奈。
是不是他妈又要让你买什么东西了？他们家还有完没完了，就买了婚房再装个修，家电家具全是你家往里添的，再说了那房子还是婚前财产，怎么那么会算计啊？高梅丽对于李巍打来的电话很不满意。
都到一步了，多一事不如少一事的好。夏真钰无所谓的说道，自己已经２８岁了，和李巍经人介绍交往快一年了，李巍也已经是３０岁的人了，所以他家里很痛快的买了房子又装修，催着两人五一结婚。
我真想不明白你，你说他家牛气什么啊，不就是儿子当个公务员吗，连个副科都没混上呢就高高在上的。高丽梅还是觉得李巍家里不太好相处。
我还是个临时工呢，和人家能比吗？自己毕业舅舅就给安排了个工作，在区政府当内勤，虽说没编制，但也乐得轻松自在。可在那种人际关系复杂的地方，没后台又没钱就算是个没编制的临时工也占不到好位置，没干三个月呢就被调到了基层的办事大厅变成了勤杂工，成天被指使得团团转。
你就是个没志气的，那个破工作还能干这么多年，要我说趁早辞职，在哪都挣得比那多。
你也知道我这人最大的优点就是懒惰啊，再说了我舅再三让我妈嘱咐我好好珍惜这分工作，我妈老观念你是知道，要是我辞职了，我就得先做好被她老人家折磨疯的准备。自己确实没什么大志向，在一个地方呆得时间长了也没了再出去闯荡的勇气了。
高梅丽想了想也是，又说道：懒惰还优点啊，你要是没能力我也就不说什么了，可明明一个很聪明的人就是一身懒肉，错过了多少好机会啊。李巍他妈这边你怎么办？你还有钱吗？
我还有一些，不过也不太多了
要是不够，我手里还有些钱，你先拿去用。
那倒不用，没钱了就不买了他妈还能怎么样。夏真钰还真没把这事儿放在心上，只不过觉得吃完饭也不能回家休息，还得去李巍家真是痛苦。
什么时候登记？蜜月去哪？高丽梅想了想还是聊些比较高兴的事儿好了。
夏真钰有些担忧的看着高丽梅，犹豫了一下说：我说了，你可别和我喊啊，我最怕别人大小声了。
你这话奇怪了，你什么时候登记，去哪度蜜月我生气什么啊？难道还能不去度蜜月了，真是的。
夏真钰先挑好点的消息说：这个月２７号去登记，李巍选的说是谐音爱妻二个字。

还真难得啊，那个呆瓜还能想到和浪漫有关的事，蜜月呢？
不去了。
高丽梅认为自己实在是没听清夏真钰说的是什么地方：去哪？我没听明白。
不去了，我们二个不去度蜜月了。
高丽梅差点从座位上跳起来，声音一下拔得老高：夏真钰，你是不是和我开玩笑呢？婚车他们家想省钱不租我们也就忍了，我们自己想办法接娘家人了，现在连度蜜月的钱也出不起了？这婚别结了！说了不让你喊的。夏真钰看周围有人向这边张望，有些不好意思。
我早说了，没那个能耐就没逞能，他们姓李的要面子，买个百十来平的房子，结果把家里花个底儿朝天，还装大款呢，现在可好除了房子他们家倒是一分钱也不想花了！高丽梅被气得不行。
他家不也是不想贷款然后让我们背一身债嘛，再说也不完全因为钱，李巍他们单位最近要迎接一个重要检查，年底要总结考评计分的，虽然是婚假无可非议，但如果这时候不在难免又不招领导待见了。其实夏真钰是想货款买房的，这样手头比较宽裕些，不像现在钱全搭在房子上了。
屁话！他就是个窝囊废，休个婚假都怕得罪领导啊，他怎么混的啊，要是不走狗屎运剜门盗洞的找人考了个公务员，他李巍就得饿死！高丽梅越想越气，也越发瞧不起李巍。
夏真钰说道：行啦，又不是什么大事，以后有机会还能补上。
高丽梅真是恨铁不成钢：那感觉能一样吗！你呀，就是什么也不往心里去，结婚这么大的事你也处理得这么草率，将来可别后悔。
两人又聊了会儿便分开了，夏真钰直接去了李巍家，刚进门李巍的妈妈宋娟便迎了过来，眼睛直往夏真钰身后看：真钰啊，你爸妈呢，没和你一起过来？
夏真钰当然不会让父母过来了，这未来的婆婆不知道又要做什么呢，自己先有个谱就行了，还能让爸妈过来受气？于是微笑着说：阿姨，我刚才一直在外面办事呢，李巍打电话给我，我就直接过来了，有什么事儿和我说就行，我能做主。
我就说你是个稳重的孩子，懂事！唉，其实呢这件事确实有点为难，你也知道你们两个结婚的房子是我们家全款买的，再加上装修的钱，已经把你叔叔和我的积蓄花得差不多了。我听李巍说你们婚礼还得请４０多桌，阿姨不是哭穷有钱不给你们花，这婚宴的钱真是有些为难了。
夏真钰知道她还没说完，也不着急，果然：你叔叔和我就李巍这么一个儿子，将来什么还不都是留给你们？再说现在结婚买房小两口不背房贷的又有几个啊，我们还不是想让你们轻松点吗，而且这说出去多有面子啊，你看你是不是和你父母商量下，婚宴钱能不能负担点儿，等婚礼办完了接了礼金就把钱还给你家。
夏真钰想了想，这事儿是万万不能让父母知道的，不然真会闹起来的。于是很平静的对着李巍的妈妈说：阿姨，我明白了，但我想也不用让我爸妈知道了，我还有些钱先拿出来用吧，您也说了婚礼办完钱也就收回来了。
宋娟听了也高兴起来，能不让亲家知道最好不过了，不然将来都是让人说嘴的把柄，于是热情得留夏真钰吃了晚饭再走。
夏真钰只想赶快回家，这一个月来为了筹办婚礼的东西几乎都没休息过，明天又是周一了，真的很累，谢绝了宋娟的好意准备起身回家。
李巍送她上楼，一路上一言不发，夏真钰也习惯了，这人太内向了。李巍是在区公安部门做鉴定工作的，平时接触的都是技术上的事，本来和同事接触就少，再加上他一着急就脸红还有点结巴，又不懂为人处世那一套，所以时间长了大家就都不爱和他来往了。
快出小区大门口的时候，李巍突然停下看着夏真钰说道：我妈是真的没钱了，不是想为难你。我以后一定带你去更好的地方补回来，我们去欧洲。
夏真钰笑着说：行啦，我不在意的。你们单位也正是关键的时候，你不休假正好领导还觉得亏欠你了，以后有什么好事儿也能想着你。

那你怎么和你单位的同事解释啊？李巍担心夏真钰在单位会不好过，毕竟新婚不去度蜜月真是让人非议的事儿。
我都想好了，等婚礼前几天我就把脚包上，就说收拾房子登高不小心崴了脚，这样不去度蜜月也就好说了。夏真钰早就想好了借口，虽说也不太能瞒住单位那些人精，不过总算是个正当点的理由。
李巍有此激动：对——对不起，真钰。让你受——委屈了。
安慰了一会李巍，夏真钰打车回了家，一头倒在床上想着：不委屈啊，自己本来就不想结婚，可是又不能让父母担心。李巍，希望我们能相安无事，平平淡淡的过完一生，其实我也应该跟你说对不起。因为，我并不爱你，连喜欢都谈不上。
☆、还有更意外的事情
时间过得很快，距夏真钰和李巍登记还有一周的时间了，虽说同事们都知道她快结婚了可工作却一点也没少派给她。夏真钰几乎没有按时下班的时候，正加班录入数据的时候，李巍突然站在了她面前。
夏真钰看着眼前的李巍，有些奇怪李巍怎么会来找她，他通常不会到单位找自己的。李巍的脸色有些奇怪，似乎有些紧张。
哟，小夏这就是你未婚夫吧？来接你下班了，小俩口感情好啊，早点儿走吧。二楼下来的陈姐打量了一下李巍，眼中闪过一丝不以为然，看着这穿戴打扮就知道混得不怎么样了。
夏真钰看见了陈姐的表情也没在意，只是笑了笑说道：我把手边儿这点活儿做完就走，陈姐你先走吧。
看着陈姐出了大门，夏真钰对李巍说：怎么来了？是不是有事情？
李巍表情更加不自然了：真钰，我们找个地方谈谈好吗？
我这有点活儿没做完呢，要不先进办公室谈吧。
夏真钰带着李巍进了一间办公室，两人隔着一张办公桌，对面坐下。李巍很直接，声音有些颤抖：真钰，我有个事儿和你说，咱俩结婚后我不想要孩子。
夏真钰听了这话愣住了，试探着问：你的意思是暂时不想要孩子，还是根本就不想要孩子？
我就是不想要孩子！李巍声音更紧了，但态度非常坚决。
夏真钰有些动气了：李巍，你这想法不是现在才有的吧？我们相处这么长时间了，现在还有一个礼拜就要登记了，你才和我说你不想要小孩这个问题，是想强迫我答应你吗？

Author: The light of morning mist

☆. Can we get married like this?
Zhenyu, my mother said that the house has been almost decorated. Let the parents of both parties meet again to see if anything can be added. Xia Zhenyu sighed secretly while listening to Li Wei's stuttering voice on the phone.
I'm having dinner with Lili outside. I'll check over later. After saying that, he hung up the phone without waiting for the other party to answer, and looked at Gao Meili sitting opposite with a look of helplessness.
Are they asking you to buy something again? Their family was still finished, so they bought a wedding house and renovated it. The appliances and furniture were all added by your family. Besides, the house was pre-marital property. Why are you so calculating? Gao Meili was very dissatisfied with the call from Li Wei.
We've all reached this point, and it's better to have one less thing than one more thing. Xia Zhenyu said nonchalantly that he was already 28 years old and had been dating Li Wei for almost a year after being introduced to him. Li Wei was already 30 years old, so his family happily bought a house and renovated it, urging them to get married on May Day.
I really don't understand you. Why do you think his family is so arrogant? Isn't it just that his son is a civil servant? Gao Limei still feels that Li Wei's family is not easy to get along with.
I am still a temporary worker, can I compare with others? After I graduated, my uncle arranged a job as an in-house clerk in the district government. Although there was no establishment, I was happy and relaxed. But in a place with complex interpersonal relationships, no backstage and no money, even a temporary worker with no official establishment would not be able to get a good position. After working for only three months, he was transferred to the grassroots service hall and became a handyman. He was accused of making mistakes all day long.
You just have no ambition. You can still hold that crappy job for so many years. If you ask me to resign as soon as possible, I can earn more than that anywhere.
You also know that my biggest advantage is laziness. Besides, my uncle has repeatedly asked my mother to tell me to cherish this job. You know my mother’s old concept. If I resign, I must first be prepared to be tortured crazy by her. I really don’t have any big ambitions. After staying in one place for a long time, I no longer have the courage to go out and explore.
Gao Meili thought about it for a while and then said: There is an advantage in laziness. If you were incompetent, I wouldn't say anything. But it is obvious that a very smart person is lazy and has missed many good opportunities. Li Wei, what the hell are you going to do? Do you still have money?
I still have some, but not too many
If it's not enough, I still have some money in my hand, you can use it first.
That's not necessary. If you don't have money, you won't buy it. What else can you do. Xia Zhenyu really didn't take this matter to heart. He just felt that it was painful to go to Li Wei's house and not be able to go home to rest after dinner.
When to register? Where to go on your honeymoon? Gao Limei thought for a while and decided to talk about something happier.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Gao Limei worriedly, hesitated and said, "I told you, don't shout at me. I'm most afraid of others being too loud."
What you said is strange. When did you register and where did you go for your honeymoon? Why should I be angry? Is it possible not to go on a honeymoon? Really.
Xia Zhenyu first picked the better news and said: I went to register on the 27th of this month. The one Li Wei chose was homophonic to the word "loving wife".
It's really rare that that idiot can still think of things related to romance. Where's the honeymoon?
Not going.
Gao Limei thought that she really didn't hear clearly what Xia Zhenyu was talking about: Where to go? I didn't understand.
No, we are not going on our honeymoon.
Gao Limei almost jumped up from her seat and raised her voice in a loud voice: Xia Zhenyu, are you kidding me? They wanted to save money by not renting a wedding car, so we just tolerated it.You have tried to find a way to pick up your mother's family, but now you can't even afford the honeymoon? Don't get married! I told you not to shout. Xia Zhenyu felt a little embarrassed when he saw people looking around.
I've said it before, if you don't have the ability, you won't be able to do it. They surnamed Li want to save face and buy a house of more than 100 square meters. In the end, they spend everything on the house and pretend to be rich. Now, except for the house, their family doesn't want to spend a penny! Gao Limei was so angry.
His family doesn’t want to take out a loan and let us be in debt, and it’s not all because of money. Li Wei and his company are going to have an important inspection recently, and they will be summarizing the evaluation and scoring at the end of the year. Although it is understandable that they are on wedding leave, if they are away at this time, they will inevitably not be welcomed by the leaders. In fact, Xia Zhenyu wanted to buy a house with the money, so that he would have more money, unlike now where all the money is tied up in the house.
shit! He is just a loser. He is afraid of offending his boss even if he takes a wedding leave. How did he get away with it? If he had not been lucky enough to find someone to become a civil servant, Li Wei would have starved to death! The more Gao Limei thought about it, the angrier she became, and the more she looked down on Li Wei.
Xia Zhenyu said: "Okay, it's not a big deal. I can make up for it if I have the opportunity in the future."
Gao Limei really hates that iron cannot become steel: can the feeling be the same! You just don't take anything into your heart, and you handle such a big matter like marriage so carelessly. Don't regret it in the future.
The two chatted for a while and then separated. Xia Zhenyu went directly to Li Wei's house. As soon as he walked in, Li Wei's mother Song Juan came over and looked directly behind Xia Zhenyu: Zhenyu, where are your parents? Didn't they come with you?
Of course Xia Zhenyu won't let her parents come over. What will the future mother-in-law do? She just needs to have a record first. How can she let her parents come over to suffer? So he smiled and said: Auntie, I have been working outside just now. Li Wei called me and I came directly. If you need anything, just tell me. I can make the decision.
I just said you are a stable child and sensible! Alas, actually this matter is a bit embarrassing. You also know that the house where you two got married was bought by our family in full. Plus the decoration money, your uncle and I have spent almost all our savings. I heard Li Wei say that you have to invite more than 40 tables for your wedding. Auntie is not complaining that she is poor and has money but she won’t spend it on you. The money for the wedding banquet is really a bit difficult.
Xia Zhenyu knew that she hadn't finished speaking yet, so he wasn't in a hurry. As expected: Your uncle and I only have a son like Li Wei, so why won't we leave everything to you in the future? Besides, how many young couples are getting married and buying a house without paying the mortgage? Don’t we want to make it easier for you? And it’s so embarrassing to say it. See if you can discuss with your parents whether you can afford the wedding banquet. After the wedding is over, the gift money will be returned to your family.
Xia Zhenyu thought for a while, and he must not let his parents know about this, otherwise it would really cause trouble. So I calmly said to Li Wei's mother: Auntie, I understand, but I don't think I need to let my parents know. I still have some money, so let's use it first. You also said that the money will be recovered after the wedding.
Song Juan was also happy after hearing this. It was best not to let her in-laws know, otherwise she would be a source of gossip in the future, so she was so enthusiastic that she stayed with Xia Zhenyu for dinner before leaving.
Xia Zhenyu just wanted to go home quickly. He had hardly rested in the past month to prepare for the wedding. Tomorrow was Monday again. He was really tired. He declined Song Juan's kindness and was ready to go home.
Li Wei sent her upstairs without saying a word all the way. Xia Zhenyu was used to it. This person was too introverted. Li Wei works as an expert in the district public security department. He is usually exposed to technical matters and has little contact with his colleagues. In addition, he blushes and stutters a bit when he is anxious, and he does not understand how to behave in the world. Therefore, over time, no one likes to interact with him.
Hurry out of the community gateWhile talking, Li Wei suddenly stopped and looked at Xia Zhenyu and said: My mother really has no money. I don't want to embarrass you. I will definitely take you to a better place to make up for it in the future. Let’s go to Europe.
Xia Zhenyu smiled and said, "Okay, I don't care." This is also a critical time for your company. If you don't take a vacation, your boss will still feel that he owes you. He will think of you if anything good happens in the future.
Then how do you explain it to your colleagues in your unit? Li Wei was worried that Xia Zhenyu would have a hard time at work. After all, it was really scandalous for a newlywed to not go on their honeymoon.
I had already thought about it, and I had my feet bandaged a few days before the wedding. I said that I accidentally sprained my feet while climbing up the house, so it would be easy to avoid going on the honeymoon. Xia Zhenyu had already thought of an excuse. Although he couldn't hide it from the people in the unit, it was still a legitimate reason.
Li Wei was so excited: Yes - I'm sorry, Zhenyu. Let you suffer - wronged.
After comforting Li Wei for a while, Xia Zhenyu took a taxi back home and fell on the bed, thinking: No, I don't want to get married, but I can't let my parents worry. Li Wei, I hope we can live in peace and live a normal life. In fact, I should also say sorry to you. Because, I don't love you, I can't even talk about liking you.
☆. There are more unexpected things
Time flies by very quickly, and there is still a week left before Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei register. Although her colleagues know that she is getting married soon, they still have no less work for her. When Xia Zhenyu almost didn't get off work on time and was working overtime to enter data, Li Wei suddenly stood in front of her.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Li Wei in front of him, wondering why Li Wei came to her. He usually wouldn't come to his work to look for him. Li Wei's face looked a little strange, and he seemed a little nervous.
Oh, Xiaoxia, this is your fiancé, right? I'm here to pick you up after get off work. The two of you are in good terms, so please leave early. Sister Chen, who came down from the second floor, looked at Li Wei with a flash of disapproval in her eyes. Looking at his attire, he knew he was not doing well.
Xia Zhenyu saw Sister Chen's expression and didn't care. He just smiled and said, "I'll finish the work at hand and leave. Sister Chen, you go first."
Seeing Sister Chen walking out of the door, Xia Zhenyu said to Li Wei: Why are you here? Is something wrong?
Li Wei's expression became even more unnatural: Zhenyu, can we find a place to talk?
I have some unfinished work, why don't we go to the office to talk.
Xia Zhenyu took Li Wei into an office, and the two sat down opposite each other across a desk. Li Wei was very direct and his voice was trembling: Zhenyu, I have something to tell you. I don’t want children after we get married.
Xia Zhenyu was stunned after hearing this, and asked tentatively: Do you mean you don't want children for the time being, or you don't want children at all?
I just don't want kids! Li Wei's voice became tighter, but his attitude was very firm.
Xia Zhenyu became a little angry: Li Wei, didn't you just come up with this idea now? We have been together for such a long time, and now we are going to register in a week. You just told me that you don’t want children. Do you want to force me to agree to you?
